description: This file defines the InboundEmailTester class within the Step\Acceptance namespace. It contains methods for navigating to email settings and creating bounce email accounts, utilizing other tester classes and faker data for form filling.

classes.name: InboundEmailTester
classes.description: A test helper class for inbound email related acceptance tests, providing functions to navigate email settings and create bounce email accounts.

methods.name: gotoEmailSettings
methods.description: Navigates to the inbound email settings page via the user menu.

methods.name: createBounceEmail
methods.description: Fills out and submits the form to create a new bounce handling email account with faker data.
